notes.text: There’s something so beautiful about travelling on a bus and quietly observing people. It’s like watching a real-life play where you never get to hear the full plot—you only catch faces, gestures, movement, and fleeting moments between strangers. Pure visuals, framed by a moving window. It calibrates your brain in a way almost nothing else can, changing how you see the world, read people, and parse truth.
Everything is integer in both the physical & digital realms.
You can learn anything just by doing side projects, committing a fuckton of mistakes, and iterating.
